comments.mergedPostDetails:
My setup is weird: this is reproduced on VRChat 2026.2.1 using Monado 25.1.0, OpenComposite 1.0.1521, Proton GE-Proton10-34, all on NixOS unstable 2026-05-23

No gestures that require thumb-down input are possible. In other words, I can only do the following gestures (verified using the avatar debug menu):

0	Neutral

2	HandOpen

5	RockNRoll

6	HandGun

7	ThumbsUp

Visually, it looks like I should be able to trigger the `Fist` and `FingerPoint` gestures, as the model's fist and finger point animation states are (or at least appear to be) triggered.

Gesture states that require "NOT thumb-up" are interruptible by providing touch input on the face buttons (e.g. attempting to trigger `FingerPoint` doesn't trigger `HandGun`).

## Relevant technical details of Monado

I'm not too familiar with OpenXR or Monado, but this is this is a best-effort attempt to provide relevant context. It seems like this might be just a minor threshold change.

Monado handles input for Index controllers by giving a `1.0f` thumb value when buttons are touched, which I would expect VRChat to register as a thumb-down input: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/monado/monado/-/blob/main/src/xrt/drivers/vive/vive_controller.c?ref_type=heads#L367-412

Which in turn gets converted to XRHand values here: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/monado/monado/-/blob/main/src/xrt/auxiliary/util/u_hand_simulation.c#L409-413
